assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG FPS weapon ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for an original gothic steampunk horde shooter. PORTRAIT canvas. STRICT regular grid: 3 equal columns by 7 equal rows, each cell separated by generous fully transparent gutters. No labels, no grid lines, no background, no hands, no UI, no watermark. Each ROW is ONE distinct weapon, all three columns repeat the SAME design and SAME first-person view. Camera is player's eye, rear breech occupies lower RIGHT of each cell, barrel foreshortens toward UPPER LEFT. NOT side-view inventory icons, NOT isometric. Weapon fully inside its cell with 12% clear padding. Detailed hand-painted raster sprites, crisp silhouette, worn steel, engraved brass, dark burgundy wood, convincing volumetric paint, old-school FPS sprite aesthetic (not vector polygons). Consistent scale and view among animation frames, transparent alpha absolutely essential. 3 columns, exactly 7 rows, 21 cells.
